interface CoercingValue { get value(): number; set value(v: number | string); }
class CoercingCounter implements CoercingValue {
  private n = 0;
  get value(): number { return this.n; }
  set value(v: number | string) { this.n = Number(v); }
}
const counter = new CoercingCounter();
counter.value = "3";
const contract: CoercingValue = counter;
contract.value = "4";
const readNumber: number = counter.value;
console.log(readNumber + 1);
const object = { n: 0, get value(): number { return this.n; }, set value(v: number | string) { this.n = Number(v); } };
object.value = "5";
object["value"] = "6";
console.log(object.value + 1);
interface ReadValue { get value(): number; }
const readonlyValue: ReadValue = { get value() { return 8; } };
console.log(readonlyValue.value + 1);
const receiver = { read() { return this.value + 1; }, n: 0, get value(): number { return this.n; }, set value(v: number | string) { this.n = Number(v); } };
receiver.value = "9";
console.log(receiver.read());
